segments.title: You wrote it. Detector says AI.
segments.say: You wrote it yourself, and an AI detector still says it's AI.

segments.title: Detectors guess
segments.say: AI detectors give a guess, not proof. They can flag human writing.

segments.title: Keep proof of your work
segments.say: So keep proof: version history, your notes, and early drafts.

segments.title: Where to find it
segments.say: Google Docs and Word both keep version history for files saved online.
Save this before your next deadline, and follow for honest AI tips.
